details: Critical Update Storm: the brush handler fires on every mousemove, iterating all 1M points to update the visibility array, uploading a 4MB Float32Array via gl.bufferSubData, and re-running the full histogram bin loop—all synchronously with no RAF coalescing, debounce, or dirty-flag guard. No transitions are used (so no handoff race), scales are static pre-computed pixel arrays (no stale closure risk), and there is no cross-view dispatch (no infinite loop risk).
